statements.description: The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to an accessory building or its extension if it meets all of the following conditions: it stands on the ground; is located in a rear yard area; is more than 1 meter away from publicly accessible areas; is not higher than 5 meters; if it has more than one floor, living areas are only on the first floor; and it does not have a roof terrace, balcony, or other outdoor space not on the ground.

The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to a recreational overnight stay building if it meets all of the following conditions: it stands on the ground; is not higher than 5 meters; and has a surface area not exceeding 70 square meters.

The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to a dormer in the front roof slope or a side roof slope facing publicly accessible areas if all the following conditions are met: it is located in an area or on a building designated in the temporary part of this environmental plan under Article 22.1(a) of the Environmental Act as an area or building to which no reasonable aesthetic requirements apply; it has a flat roof; its height measured from the base of the dormer does not exceed 1.75 meters; its bottom edge is more than 0.5 meters and less than 1 meter above the roof base; its top edge is more than 0.5 meters below the roof ridge; and its sides are more than 0.5 meters from the sides of the roof slope.

statements.description: The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to a sports or play device other than for solely private use if it meets both of the following conditions: it is not higher than 4 meters; and it functions only by means of gravity or human physical force.

The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to a swimming pool, hot tub, or similar facility, or a pond on the building plot of a house or residential building, provided it is not covered by a roof.

statements.description: The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to an estate or plot boundary if all of the following conditions are met: it is higher than 1 meter but not higher than 2 meters; it is on an estate or plot where a building already exists with which the boundary has a functional relationship; and it is located behind the line running parallel to the front of that building along the adjacent publicly accessible area.

The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to a non-building structure in a rear yard area used for agricultural business operations, limited to either a silo or another structure not higher than 2 meters.

The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to a pipeline, except for pipelines to which Article 2.29, under p, introductory and under 4, of the Decree on Environmental Structures applies.

statements.description: The prohibition in Article 22.26 does not apply to activities related to an altered building if all of the following conditions are met: there is no increase in the built-up surface area; there is no increase in the building volume; and it is not a building as referred to in Article 2.29, under b through r, of the Decree on Environmental Structures that fails to meet the requirements set for that building in those parts.
